title: Valid Palindrome
description: Given a string s, determine whether it is a palindrome after converting all uppercase letters into lowercase letters and removing all non-alphanumeric characters. Return true if it is a palindrome, otherwise return false.
constraints: s consists of printable ASCII characters

sample_test_cases.input: "A man, a plan, a canal: Panama"
sample_test_cases.explanation: After removing non-alphanumeric characters and converting to lowercase, the string becomes 'amanaplanacanalpanama', which is a palindrome.

test_cases.input: "A man, a plan, a canal: Panama"
"Was it a car or a cat I saw?"
"Able was I ere I saw Elba"

hints: Only alphanumeric characters should be considered.
Uppercase and lowercase letters should be treated as the same.
Try using two pointers, one from the beginning and one from the end.
Skip non-alphanumeric characters while comparing.
explanation: First preprocess the string by ignoring all non-alphanumeric characters and treating uppercase and lowercase letters as equal. Then use two pointers: one starting from the beginning and one from the end. Move both pointers toward the center while comparing characters. If all corresponding characters match, the string is a palindrome; otherwise, it is not.

title: Reverse Words in a String
description: Given an input string s, reverse the order of the words. A word is defined as a sequence of non-space characters. The returned string should contain the words in reverse order separated by a single space. Leading, trailing, and multiple spaces between words should be removed.
constraints: s contains English letters, digits, punctuation, and spaces

sample_test_cases.explanation: The words are reversed while maintaining a single space between them.

hints: Split the string into words.
Ignore extra spaces.
Reverse the order of the words.
Join the words using a single space.
explanation: Extract all valid words from the string while ignoring extra spaces. Reverse the order of these words and join them together with a single space between each word. The final result should not contain leading, trailing, or multiple consecutive spaces.

title: Longest Common Prefix
description: Write a function to find the longest common prefix string amongst an array of strings. If there is no common prefix, return an empty string.
constraints: strs[i] consists of lowercase English letters

sample_test_cases.explanation: The longest common prefix shared by all strings is 'fl'.

hints: The common prefix cannot be longer than the shortest string.
Compare characters position by position across all strings.
Stop as soon as a mismatch is found.
Try using the first string as a reference.
explanation: Use the first string as a reference and compare each character position with the corresponding character in all other strings. If every string contains the same character at that position, continue. As soon as a mismatch occurs or a string ends, return the prefix built so far. If no common prefix exists, return an empty string.

title: String Compression
description: Given a string s consisting of lowercase English letters, compress it using run-length encoding. Replace each sequence of consecutive identical characters with the character followed by its count. Return the compressed string.
constraints: s consists of lowercase English letters only

sample_test_cases.explanation: The character 'a' appears 3 times consecutively, 'b' appears 2 times, and 'c' appears 1 time.

hints: Process the string from left to right.
Count consecutive occurrences of the same character.
When the character changes, append the previous character and its count.
Don't forget to process the final group after the loop ends.
explanation: Traverse the string while maintaining a count of consecutive occurrences of the current character. Whenever the character changes, append the current character followed by its count to the result. Reset the count for the new character and continue. After processing the entire string, append the last character group and return the compressed string.

title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
description: Given a string s, find the length of the longest substring without repeating characters.
constraints: s consists of English letters, digits, symbols and spaces

sample_test_cases.explanation: The longest substring without repeating characters is "abc", which has length 3.

hints: A brute-force solution checking all substrings will be too slow.
Try maintaining a window containing unique characters.
When a duplicate character is found, move the left boundary of the window.
Track the maximum window size encountered during traversal.
explanation: Use the sliding window technique. Maintain a window containing only unique characters. Expand the right pointer while characters remain unique. When a duplicate character is encountered, move the left pointer until the duplicate is removed. The maximum size of this valid window during traversal is the answer.

title: Group Anagrams

constraints: strs[i] consists of lowercase English letters

sample_test_cases.explanation: Words that contain the same characters are grouped together.

hints: Anagrams have the same characters with the same frequencies.

Use a hash map to group words sharing the same signature.
explanation: Two words are anagrams if they contain the same characters in a different order. Create a canonical representation for each word, such as its sorted character sequence. Use this representation as a key in a hash map and group all words with the same key together. Finally, return all the groups.

constraints: s consists of English letters and digits

sample_test_cases.explanation: "bab" and "aba" are both valid answers because they are the longest palindromic substrings.

Perform this for both odd-length and even-length palindromes. Track the longest palindrome encountered and return it at the end.
